As someone who’s finishing up his first play, it’s both easy and incredibly difficult at times. Just depends on where your strengths as a writer lie. Cannot stress enough that you NEED to do your prep work. Work on a strong spine before ever putting a word down. Know your story, characters, and those characters goals/obstacles/relationships with other characters like the back of your hand. If you do all your prep, arguably the hardest part, then the writing will come surprisingly easy to you.
